messages.content: Tell me some of the major airports in the United States.

message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, sorted roughly by passenger traffic (largest to smaller but still significant):

| Airport | City | State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|------|-------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | Atlanta | GA | ATL | Largest by passenger traffic in the world; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport | Los Angeles | CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and the Pacific; hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | Chicago | IL | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; hub for United Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | Dallas/Fort Worth | TX | DFW | Hub for American Airlines; one of the largest single-runway airports. |
| Denver International Airport | Denver | CO | DEN | Largest airport by land area in the U.S.; hub for United and Southwest. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | New York City | NY | JFK | Major international gateway; hub for many carriers including Delta and American. |
| San Francisco International Airport | San Francisco | CA | SFO | Hub for United and a major gateway to Asia. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | Seattle | WA | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a major gateway to Asia. |
| Miami International Airport | Miami | FL | MIA | Major hub for international flights to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport | Charlotte | NC | CLT | Hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport | Phoenix | AZ | PHX | Hub for American Airlines; major domestic and international hub. |
| Orlando International Airport | Orlando | FL | MCO | Major hub for leisure travelers; hub for Southwest. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport | Newark | NJ | EWR | Major hub for United Airlines; gateway to Europe. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport | Detroit | MI | DTW | Hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport | Dulles | VA | IAD | Major hub for United Airlines; gateway to Europe. |
| Minneapolis–Saint Paul International Airport | Minneapolis | MN | MSP | Hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Boston Logan International Airport | Boston | MA | BOS | Major hub for Boston‑based airlines like JetBlue and Delta. |
| San Diego International Airport | San Diego | CA | SAN | Major hub for Southwest Airlines. |
| Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport | Baltimore | MD | BWI | Major hub for Southwest Airlines. |
| Philadelphia International Airport | Philadelphia | PA | PHL | Major hub for United Airlines. |

These airports are among the busiest in the country and serve as major hubs for both domestic and international travel.
